propositions: The AC1 cross-surface equivalence contract in test_operation_snapshot_surfaces.py does not drive real MCP or reconciler entry points; instead it re-calls the same composer function with identical arguments, making the test vacuous and unable to catch parity bugs

The test must invoke the real MCP entry point (build_server + call_tool) and the real reconciler main() argv entry point rather than re-composing, and capture their actual operation snapshots through a recorder bound to the module global

Each surface must assert its own snapshot against absolute expected content (repo root, envelope version, config keys) in addition to cross-surface comparison, because perturbing the composer would otherwise move all surfaces together and leave the contract green

The recorder must fire and produce at least one captured snapshot per surface, or the test fails with an explicit message naming that surface, preventing silent no-ops when a surface stops routing through the composer
